name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover sewer backup cleanup?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover sewer backup cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many standard homeowner's insurance policies do not automatically cover sewer backup damage. Often, it requires a specific endorsement or rider to be added to your policy. It is crucial to review your policy documents or contact your insurance provider directly to understand your coverage. Alpha-Plumbing Services LLC can assist with documentation and communication with your insurer regarding the scope of work, but policy coverage is determined by your insurance company.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard homeowner's insurance often excludes sewer backup; a specific rider may be needed. Check your policy or contact your insurer for details.
